title: Grateful Dead Live at Pelletier Farm on 1969-08-23

ai_review.summary: A very good remaster of a soundboard recording, though details about the performance are scarce
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this release four stars and praises the new remaster as “very good,” noting that it’s being seeded on a community site. No specific comments are made about the concert itself, song selection, or individual musicians, and the show date remains unknown.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single, brief review is available; it rates the recording positively but provides no detail on performance, so rating reflects decent remaster quality with high uncertainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered version described as “very good”; no specific issues or flaws mentioned.
